speaker: cateye81
transcript:
Rich, I think you found the piece we were missing.

Revelation gives us the Beast—the Antichrist, the man of lawlessness—and a false prophet that convinces people the Beast is salvation.

Look at Gravitas.

Government, news, hospitals—gone.

Gravitas replaced all of them.

It controls the signal, the medicine, the drones, and the maps.

Every message says keep your device on, give us your location, obey the machine.

Gravitas is the Beast.

That calm voice is its false prophet.

The Antichrist does not need horns.

It can arrive as the only company still answering the phone.
summary: CatEye81 interprets Gravitas through Revelation while distinguishing belief from proof.
